element_id.description: Semantic element ID from that snapshot; use this or x/y, never both.
element_id.title: Element Id

project_id.description: Opaque project ID returned by projects_list; never send a local path.
project_id.title: Project Id

purpose.description: Concise user-facing reason shown in Windows approval and local activity history.
purpose.title: Purpose

session_id.description: Frontend session ID returned by frontend_session_start.
session_id.title: Session Id

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot ID that minted this target registry.
snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id

x.description: Viewport x coordinate from that snapshot; requires y and excludes element_id.
x.title: X

y.description: Viewport y coordinate from that snapshot; requires x and excludes element_id.
y.title: Y
